title: What's New in World of Warcraft: Forever
description: Daily World of Warcraft: Forever news with Alder and Pip: hotfixes, blue posts, streamers, guilds, community buzz and the Chronicle of Glurp Glurp. Includes the Azeroth Unearthed special series on the lore and history behind the game. Alder and Pip are original AI-voiced characters.
